subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference for FinTechCo — scheduling & budget timing

Date: 2026-10-28T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — quick demo?

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for the time on the intro call last week — really enjoyed hearing how FinTechCo is thinking about embedding LLMs into your customer support workflows. I wanted to get a demo scheduled so we can show the latency/cost profile and talk through deployment options (hosted vs dedicated).

Would next Tue, Nov 2 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 45m demo? If not, I can do Wed Nov 3 11:00 AM PT as an alternative.

A few things we'll cover:
- end-to-end demo of a support summarization flow
- expected latency/cost at 10 TPS and at 100 TPS
- deployment and security options for PCI-sensitive data

If Nov 2/3 isn't good, do you have a window the week of Nov 16? I know many teams are finishing budget cycles that week so happy to move.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the follow-up. Unfortunately this week and next are tied up for us — Q4 planning and a leadership offsite. Also a couple of our PMs are traveling (Tom included) so Nov 2/3 won't work.

We are generally available the week of Nov 16; would Nov 16 or Nov 18 morning PT work? Also heads up: our finance/ops team has a short spend freeze between Nov 1–15 while they reset FY budgets, so anything that needs PO/invoice approvals will likely land after the freeze.

Can you hold a space and we can lock once budgets are confirmed?
